description:
Analysis extent for Earthquake, Indonesia, 5 August 2018 (EQ20180805IDN): 3 features merged from 3 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Damage assessment of Gumantar and Dangiang Desa, Kagayan District, Lombok Island, Indonesia](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-of-gumantar-and-dangiang-desa-kagayan-district-lombok-island-indonesia-2836)
- [Potential Informal Gathering Sites over Tanjung & Pemenang Districts, Indonesia](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/potential-informal-gathering-sites-over-tanjung-pemenang-districts-indonesia-2838)
- [Potentially Damaged Buildings & Gathering Sites over Gili Islands, Lombok Utara District, Indonesia](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/potentially-damaged-buildings-gathering-sites-over-gili-islands-lombok-utara-district-indonesia-2837)
- [Potentially affected settlements over Tanjung and Pemenang Districts, Lombok Utara Regency, Nusa Tenggara Barat Province](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/potentially-affected-settlements-over-tanjung-and-pemenang-districts-lombok-utara-regency-nusa-)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: Sensor_Dat
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
